sources.entry: Note Mark - Minimal web-based Markdown notes app. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Note Mark is a minimal, web-based Markdown notes app that stores notes as standard files and folders in a file/folder system.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Note Mark as a fast, minimal, web-based Markdown notes app with a responsive web UI. It supports GitHub Flavored Markdown and offers multiple views for a note, such as rendered and plain. Notes are stored in a standard file/folder system, and the project says this keeps the user in control of their data. Other listed features include friendly URLs, dark and light themes, note sharing, an editor with keyboard shortcuts, and uploading and attaching assets. OIDC support for single sign-on is also listed.
use_cases: web-based notes app with markdown rendering
sharing notes with others via links
attaching images and files to notes
single sign-on for a notes app via OIDC
keeping notes as plain files I can move or back up
notable: Notes stored as plain files in a standard folder structure, so they can be transferred at any time
Multiple views per note, including rendered and plain
Built-in note sharing and asset upload
caveats: The README does not include install or run instructions; it links to external documentation
Demo and install video is listed as work in progress
